title: InventoryAvailabilityChanged v1 payload
description: A binary-tracked item was marked available or unavailable at one location (ADR 0017). Symmetric by construction: available carries the direction, so a dish going off and a dish coming back are the same event type. reasonCode is a stable code and never free text: a typed reason would be personal data on a topic and untranslatable in a consumer's own UI. Never a product or variant name — a consumer resolves that through the authorized catalog API with variantId.
